name: Air-magnetic breaker reference
summary: Identifies the documented air-magnetic interruption construction on a legacy or selected breaker drawing.
description: Identifies the documented air-magnetic interruption construction on a legacy or selected breaker drawing. A switching-device operating reference adds the specific mechanism or duty context needed to interpret its place in a power circuit. The same basic switching outline can serve different equipment constructions, so the added description must remain attached to its device tag.

In a medium-voltage switchgear drawing, the operating reference helps the reader distinguish the interrupting device from its isolation, earthing and auxiliary-control interfaces. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Power circuit and trip release” at the input and “Air-magnetic interrupted path” at the output. The drawing does not establish replacement compatibility.
